# sreagent_github_settings (Data Source)

The GitHub App installation's settings. Needs a connected installation. One row per organization: creating it adopts the current settings, destroying it leaves them in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_github_settings" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) The installation's account.
- `auto_pr_enabled` (Boolean) Open fix PRs automatically.
- `auto_revise_on_review` (Boolean) Revise a PR when a review asks.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether an installation is connected.
- `context_repo` (String) A repository whose files give reviews context.
- `draft_prs` (Boolean) Open PRs as drafts.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `installation_id` (Number) The installation id.
- `link_comments_enabled` (Boolean) Comment links on linked issues.
- `review_enabled` (Boolean) Review pull requests.
- `review_severity_floor` (String) The lowest severity a review comments on.
